C243.notes: SER EU-FR-001. Photo confirmed · Joseph: It feels very light — the aluminum tell. Reverse RF · big 5 FRANCS in laurel wreath · 1946 · Paris cornucopia + Bazor wing (obverse Marianne/Liberté not shown). Lavrillier-type postwar aluminum 5 Fr — struck while France was rebuilding and nickel was still scarce; these featherweight pieces rode Métro pockets and café tills in the Fourth Republic years before the 1960 nouveau franc. First 5 Francs franc-era piece in the flips (your C049 is the later 10 F Génie; Swiss fivers are C065/C066). Completely different chapter from the nickel Semeuse 1 Fr run (C059/C012/C025…). Aluminum postwar type — not silver; Joseph noted it feels very light. SER siblings: EU-FR-001 (sole postwar Al 5 Fr) · era bookend vs nickel Semeuse francs. France flips now 33.
C243.story: A 1946 French 5-franc coin, struck just after the Second World War. The front shows Marianne, the symbol of France, wearing a laurel wreath, by André Lavrillier; the back shows 5 FRANCS inside a laurel wreath with the letters RF (République Française). Struck in aluminium.
